title: TTHE: Test-Time Harness Evolution
summary_zh: 测试时只用无标签执行轨迹演化候选 Harness 种群；求解器、提议器、裁判共用一个冻结模型，各有不同 Harness。
summary_en: Evolves a population of candidate harnesses at test time using only unlabeled execution trajectories; the solver, proposer, and judge share one frozen model, each with a different harness.
result_zh: BIRD 执行准确率 12.7%→48.7%（十次投票基线 16.0%）；演化出的 Harness 可迁移到其他模型。
result_en: BIRD execution accuracy 12.7%→48.7% (ten-vote baseline 16.0%); the evolved harness transfers to other models.

title: Hyperagents (DGM-H)
summary_zh: 任务 Agent 与元 Agent 合并成同一个可编辑程序，元层修改程序本身也可改。
summary_en: Merges the task agent and meta agent into a single editable program; the program that makes meta-level edits can itself be modified.
result_zh: 在编码、论文评审、机器人奖励设计、奥赛数学批改上都超过 DGM；元层改进可跨领域迁移。最常引的元改进基线。
result_en: Exceeds DGM in coding, paper reviewing, robot reward design, and Olympiad mathematics grading; meta-level improvements transfer across domains. The most frequently cited meta-improvement baseline.

title: RSIFlow: Adaptive Self-Improvement Workflows with an Evolving Meta-Agent
summary_zh: 按轨迹诊断瓶颈，动态选择面向不同组件的改进工作流；元 Agent 把结果提炼成组件技能与跨组件原则，再更新自己的 Harness。
summary_en: Diagnoses bottlenecks from trajectories and dynamically selects improvement workflows for different components; a meta agent distills outcomes into component skills and cross-component principles, then updates its own harness.
result_zh: 六个基准、两个基础模型上评估；定量结果待细读。
result_en: Evaluated on six benchmarks and two base models; quantitative results need close reading.

title: Harness Updating Is Not Harness Benefit
summary_zh: 「产出好更新」的能力与模型强弱几乎无关（Qwen3.5-9B 接近 Claude Opus 4.6）；「从更新中获益」则非单调，中等模型获益最大。
summary_en: The ability to produce good updates is almost unrelated to model strength (Qwen3.5-9B is close to Claude Opus 4.6); the ability to benefit from updates is nonmonotonic, with medium-sized models benefiting most.

title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
summary_zh: 按执行反馈修订冻结模型外的协议模块并沿固定能力树继承；评测技能另行准备。
summary_en: Revises protocol modules around a frozen model using execution feedback and inherits them along a fixed capability tree; evaluation skills are prepared separately.
